content_sections.heading: KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification depends on the advertised post. PUC-level positions generally require 2nd PUC or a recognized equivalent qualification , while degree-level posts require the prescribed Bachelor's degree or professional qualification. Candidates applying for the Second Division Assistant and other PUC-level posts must possess the prescribed 2nd PUC, Class 12 or equivalent qualification recognized under the applicable recruitment rules. Equivalent qualifications may include those recognized through Karnataka Government orders or the relevant education authorities, subject to the specific notification. Candidates applying for First Division Assistant and other degree-level posts must hold a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university or satisfy the equivalent qualification prescribed for the relevant position. Depending on the post, additional qualifications may include a specific degree discipline, professional training, computer knowledge or work experience. Important Eligibility Notice: Candidates should not assume that a general Bachelor's degree qualifies them for every FDA-level vacancy or that 2nd PUC is sufficient for every SDA-level position. Certain posts require specific subjects or additional qualifications. The Kalyana Karnataka notifications contain specific local-cadre reservation and eligibility provisions. Candidates claiming local-cadre benefits must satisfy the relevant conditions and possess the required supporting certificates. Applicants should read the separate Kalyana Karnataka recruitment notification before claiming local reservation benefits.

content_sections.heading: What is the Full Form of FDA and SDA in KEA Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: In the KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 , FDA stands for First Division Assistant , while SDA stands for Second Division Assistant . Both are administrative and clerical positions in various Karnataka government departments and corporations. FDA generally involves higher-level administrative responsibilities, whereas SDA focuses on routine clerical work, record maintenance, data entry and office support.

content_sections.heading: Difference Between FDA and SDA in Karnataka Government Jobs
content_sections.text: Key Difference: FDA is generally a higher-level administrative post requiring a Bachelor's degree, while SDA is a lower-level clerical post generally requiring 2nd PUC (12th Pass). FDA positions typically offer higher pay and greater responsibilities than SDA positions. However, the exact qualifications, salary scales and duties depend on the department and specific post mentioned in the KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 notification.

content_sections.heading: KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through a competitive examination followed by verification of certificates and eligibility, in accordance with the applicable recruitment rules. Competitive Written Examination: Candidates appear in the prescribed examination papers relevant to their recruitment category. Merit and Shortlisting: Examination marks and the applicable selection rules determine candidates considered for further stages. Document Verification: Candidates must produce original qualifications, identity documents and reservation or local-cadre certificates, as applicable. Final Selection: Recommendations will be made under the applicable post-wise and category-wise recruitment rules. Certain positions may have additional qualification or eligibility requirements. Candidates should refer to the respective notification for the full selection procedure.

content_sections.heading: KEA FDA SDA Exam Pattern 2027
content_sections.text: The notifications prescribe an offline OMR-based competitive examination. The general written examination includes two papers carrying 100 marks each , with a duration of two hours per paper. The papers cover the subjects prescribed in the relevant notification, including General Knowledge and language-related components. Candidates should check the specific examination syllabus corresponding to their application category. The notifications prescribe a penalty of 0.25 marks for an incorrect response in the objective examination, subject to the applicable question-paper instructions. Applicants should follow the OMR marking and examination-day instructions issued by KEA.

content_sections.heading: KEA FDA SDA Exam Date 2027
content_sections.text: KEA has scheduled the recruitment examinations during January 2027. The announced examination dates include 8, 9, 10, 16 and 17 January 2027 across the recruitment groups. Candidates should refer to their relevant cadre notification and subsequent admission ticket for the exact examination date, session, reporting time and centre.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KEA has announced 5,431 vacancies, including 2,163 RPC degree-level posts, 2,070 RPC PUC-level posts, 563 Kalyana Karnataka degree-level posts and 635 Kalyana Karnataka PUC-level posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 25 November 2026. The last date for fee payment is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can 12th Pass candidates apply for KEA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with 2nd PUC / Class 12 or the prescribed equivalent qualification can apply for eligible PUC-level posts, subject to the post-wise requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for KEA FDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: FDA and equivalent degree-level posts generally require a recognized Bachelor's degree. Certain positions also require specific subjects, professional qualifications or computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is generally 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, and 45 years for SC, ST and Category-1 candidates, subject to the notified rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment notifications specify application fee amounts of Rs. 750, Rs. 500 and Rs. 250 depending on the applicable category and concession rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on the prescribed competitive examination, followed by document verification and other applicable recruitment procedures.

faq.question: Q8. When will the KEA FDA SDA Examination 2027 be conducted?
faq.answer: The announced examination schedule includes 8, 9, 10, 16 and 17 January 2027. The applicable date depends on the recruitment category and examination paper.

faq.question: Q9. Are Kalyana Karnataka and RPC vacancies the same?
faq.answer: No. The Residual Parent Cadre and Kalyana Karnataka cadre have separate vacancy distributions and applicable reservation rules. Candidates should check their eligibility for the specific cadre.
